Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only on a response replayed from a stored first execution.

cancelReason.description: Present when the state is CANCELLED.

cancelledAt.description: Present when the state is CANCELLED.

departedAt.description: Present once the state reached DEPARTED.

arrivedAt.description: Present once the state reached ARRIVED.

400.description: Malformed request. Types: malformed-request (bad JSON, unknown field, NUL character), idempotency-key-required, idempotency-key-invalid, invalid-limit, invalid-cursor and unknown-query-parameter.

409.description: State or capacity conflict, or Idempotency-Key reuse. Types: idempotency-key-reused (the key was already used with a different request), departure-full (ErrDepartureFull), departure-closed (ErrDepartureClosed), lane-closed (ErrLaneClosed), package-already-loaded (ErrPackageAlreadyLoaded), load-over-capacity (ErrLoadOverCapacity), load-already-exists (ErrLoadAlreadyExists), illegal-transition and concurrent-update.
